metadata.coordinate_note: First coordinate is the row (x, north-south); second is the column (y, west-east). Proven by map.js gridTile(b,c) -> (b*33+c)*2, PEEP_DIRS offsets, and 78/78 recorded sprite cross-checks.

source_session.caveat: Every recorded map change followed a minimap or 'Return to Map' click. No physical seam or dungeon-portal landing was observed. The spawn coordinates are map-entry spawns after UI navigation, not proof of a portal landing coordinate.

metadata.status_policy: VERIFIED requires legal, walkable source and destination plus observed trigger/landing evidence. Seam geometry is verified, but the server-side landing is unobserved, so seams are UNVERIFIED. Invalid coordinates are INVALID. Missing coordinates stay UNVERIFIED.

canonical_usable.label: canonical records with a non-invalid destination coordinate

topology.explanation: Legacy base = 78 seams + 34 floor chains = 112. Legacy global adds 7 entrance pairs x 2 directions = 14, giving 126. The corrected registry has 80 seams + 34 floor chains = 114 and 128 including the same 14 entrance records. The two additional seams are the missing overworld6<->overworld11 north/south adjacency. The legacy 8 SCCs are the 25-node overworld plus the seven dungeon chains; the 1-SCC global view depends on the entrance edges and is topological only.
